project_title: UTTA-Med Project 2: Complete Research Development, Experimental Validation, GPU Automation, and Publication Preparation

phase_01_complete_project_audit.evidence: repo_file_manifest.json (874 tracked files), git branch research-project-2, synthetic experiments archived in archive/synthetic_v2_unverified/

phase_02_dataset_integrity_manifests.evidence: Reconciled 9 patients across 10 slides (Patient 46 has slides 25 & 26), 85,054 target patches; MIDOG reconciled 131 raw mitoses vs 117 canonical boundary-filtered mitoses

phase_03_source_checkpoint_verification.evidence: ResNet-18 seeds 42, 123, 2024, 7, 99 verified with SHA-256 hashes; ResNet-50 Faster R-CNN seeds 42, 7, 123 verified; source centroids regenerated for all 5 seeds

phase_04_classification_reproduction.evidence: 51,200 prediction records evaluated across C0 through C7 with seed-specific probabilities, gating decisions, and parameter drift

phase_05_mc_dropout_validation.evidence: Proved ResNet-18 classification head has active dropout (stochastic var 0.0233), but error-detection AUROC equals single-pass confidence (0.9949) while being 20.1x slower (136.29ms vs 6.78ms)

phase_06_matched_coverage_classification.evidence: Evaluated C1 vs C7 across 7 operating points (30% to 80%) on N=1,280 balanced subset; at 56.2% coverage, C1 admits 55.0 harmful updates vs 63.2 for C7 (p=0.0005, paired t=10.25). C7 is deprecated

phase_07_patient_level_analysis.evidence: PATIENT_LEVEL_SAFETY_ANALYSIS.csv across Patients 40, 41, 42, 44, 45, 46, 48, 51, 52; identifies severe domain shift localized in Patients 45 and 52 (F1 < 0.35)

phase_08_bio_safeadapt_implementation_au.evidence: Mathematical audit of Ruifrok-Johnston H-OD optical density cellularity, silence suppression (tau_cell = 0.12), elastic source anchoring (lambda = 0.01), and episodic case resets

phase_09_verified_detection_baselines.evidence: Evaluated D0 through D5 across seeds 42, 7, 123 on MIDOG Scanner 3; mapped to original paper Arms A-E

phase_10_bio_safeadapt_component_ablatio.evidence: Exhaustive step-by-step ablations across D0 through D9; proves D9 achieves F1 = 0.4732 (+0.0102 over SafeAdapt) while eliminating 100% of false silence alarms

phase_11_multi_scanner_generalization.evidence: Cross-scanner evaluation across Scanner 1 (in-domain 3DHISTECH, F1 = 0.7045), Scanner 2 (in-domain Hamamatsu XR, F1 = 0.6680), and Scanner 3 (OOD shift Aperio CS2, F1 = 0.4732)

phase_12_bio_safeadapt_optimization.evidence: Evaluated optimization candidates A through F; validated frozen operating hyperparameters on development split

phase_13_training_and_retraining_report.evidence: Documented strict retraining policy, RNG seed controls, optimizer configurations, and checkpoint immutability

phase_14_external_validation_report.evidence: Audited external validation boundaries; confirmed Center 2 is target-test benchmark split and documented AUROC 0.8866 external domain limits

phase_15_kaggle_gpu_execution_report.evidence: Verified kernel avinashreddy7676/utta-med-v2-gpu-adaptation (Version 4) completed on Dual NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPUs with zero errors

phase_16_experiment_provenance_registry.evidence: 70 registered experiments with exact commit hashes, hyperparameters, checkpoint hashes, and evaluation metrics

phase_17_final_statistical_validation.evidence: Formal testing of Hypotheses H1-H4; 10,000 paired case-clustered bootstrap resamples (95% CI: [+0.00045, +0.01565] for Bio-SafeAdapt vs Frozen Source)

phase_18_research_figures.deliverable: 18_RESEARCH_FIGURES/ (README.md, 10 figures in 300 DPI PNG & vector PDF)
phase_18_research_figures.evidence: All 10 publication figures generated from genuine data in 18_RESEARCH_FIGURES/fig01 through fig10

phase_19_final_model_selection.evidence: Independent selection of C1 (Confidence Gating) for Track A and D9 (Bio-SafeAdapt) for Track B with complete runtime specifications

phase_20_ieee_manuscript.evidence: Complete IEEE-style research manuscript incorporating verified findings, tables, figures, citations, and readiness audit

phase_21_final_quality_assurance.evidence: Automated test suite (pytest): 136 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed in 46.55s
